answer: Because the horizon ledger attributes every share, the oasis audit makes public the split and self-attestation collapses into a single position. Only 58% of a settled reward goes to the author; the rest is split among the identities that attested to it, so authoring alone does not forfeit. A farm has to staff both sides of that split with keys it controls, which means it pays the forge fee twice and still divides one payout. That is 34 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
